hypothesis: Uploading the exact vocabulary head at engine open takes VRAM a 16 GB card needs for the prompt (the attention KV buffers fail to allocate and the prompt's attention falls back to the CPU); uploading it at the first head call, after the prompt, removes the allocation failures.
model: DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 architecture, abliterated weights (same shapes), safetensors, native FP8/FP4
command: make -C c cuda-dsv4-dg-dll cuda-dsv4-dll && make -C c -f Makefile.deepseek-v4 ARCH=native CUDA=1 deepseek-v4; deepseek_v4 <model> --prompt-file prompt3k.txt --max-tokens 36 --memory-gb 16 with the environment in config; tok_s = prompt tokens (3278) / time_to_first_token from the engine's `timing` line (prompt throughput, engine open included)
